The files in `op/` are unmodified copies of the duration, date, dateTime and time operator
tests of the W3C XQuery and XPath test suite (QT3), https://github.com/w3c/qt3tests, commit
201a6e466940cdfc727f4babfedcde5332b9f578 (2026-05-14).

They are covered by the dual-licensing approach described in
[LICENSES FOR W3C TEST SUITES](https://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/2008/04-testsuite-copyright.html).
